npcs.name: Albert Jr.
npcs.about: Wandering merchant who buys your items. Always on the move!

npcs.name: Andrew
npcs.about: Sells motorcycles (green, black, white, red, pink), sedans (pink, yellow, blue, black), and mountain bikes. Provides a free starter vehicle.

npcs.name: Annie
npcs.about: Music and friendship speak to them! Their shop offers instruments, emojis, and animations. Tip: New deals every day—don’t miss out!

npcs.name: Atara
npcs.about: Mayor of the city, guide to the main story, and great visionary.

npcs.name: Azure
npcs.about: Sells event tokens by selling specific items

npcs.name: Bailey J
npcs.about: The local bird expert! She will support you with rewards for your observations. She also has a shop where you can buy binoculars and bird food.

npcs.name: Bill
npcs.about: Expert in sea fishing. The sea holds no secrets for him.

npcs.name: Blanc
npcs.about: Teaches you gardening and sells starter equipment.

npcs.name: Bob
npcs.about: Our grandfather has a great talent for building. Every Saturday at 6:00 a.m., he renews the furniture display, which will be available for a week. Talk to him if you want to get natural building materials for your land.

npcs.name: Cassie
npcs.about: A mysterious character who roams the forest under the moonlight.

npcs.name: Doris
npcs.about: Unique NPC who appears only during special weather events (rain, snowfall, rainbow, meteor shower). Sells exclusive recipes like Roll Cake, rare ingredients, emotes, and meteorite furniture. Uses Star Fragments as currency for meteor items

npcs.name: Dorothee
npcs.about: A true style icon! You'll find the perfect pair of shoes in their store. The clothing selection is updated daily, so don't forget to stop by and check it out.

npcs.name: Eric
npcs.about: Friendly resident, manages daily delegations to assist the community.

npcs.name: Ka Ching
npcs.about: Owner of the general store. If you need it, she has it!

npcs.name: Massimo
npcs.about: Restaurant chef and culinary mentor. Passion in every dish.

npcs.name: Mrs. Joan
npcs.about: Owner of the pet store. Lover of all animals.

npcs.name: Naniwa
npcs.about: The entomologist at Heartopia will show you how to create delicate bubbles to capture insects. In his shop, you'll find everything you need for this hobby, including terrariums.

npcs.name: Patti
npcs.about: Expert guardian of the forests, knowledgeable about hidden trails, creatures, and changes in the environment.

npcs.name: Vanya
npcs.about: Fishing mentor. Find peace by the river.
